description: This dataset lists the operating mines of South Africa, compiled by Megan Cole over years of data collection. The Mendeley Data page says it was first developed for research on putting the Sustainable Development Goals into practice in the mining sector and on mine closure risks and opportunities, and that this February 2026 version updates and expands an earlier published dataset. It was published on 20 March 2026 as version 1, one downloadable Excel workbook of about 45 KB, under CC BY-NC 3.0, so it is free for non-commercial reuse only. Coverage is national for South Africa. Caveats: the columns (such as commodity, owner, location or status) and the number of mines are not stated on the page read, and the sources behind the list are not described there. For simulation it gives a national mine list to locate extraction sites for hazard exposure of mining regions, for power and water demand estimates at mines, and for mine closure scenarios in local economies. Related catalogue records include the Energy and Industry Facilities Composite, the WAPHA global metal mines database and the global high-resolution mining footprints.
